question: Under a causal tradable-volume budget, can the V1.7 portfolio grow faster by directing scarce slots to liquid simultaneous applicants?
single_variable: On the common covered positive-turnover universe, change only the within-clock entry priority. Compare the original lowest prior ATR, highest prior-hour native USDT turnover, and equal-weight average of ordinal ranks on these two variables (ties resolved by original ATR). No fitted weights or currency list. Readmit affected symbols, preserve nine funded slots, return collateral on real exit and run the original ETH/BTC 1x/2x leverage rule.
capacity: All arms share an entry ceiling equal to 10% of the mean per-minute turnover over the last finished native H1, directly derived from the previous-hour volume grid. Applied to actual aggregate notional across all four children. Exclude missing turnover before any accounts run. This comparison uses the previous H1 average; the separately registered original-roster scenario used a 60-minute median. Same 1000 USDT, taker 5bp/maker 2bp, then additional 5bp per market fill. Historic funding, exit depth, and market impact beyond these costs not modeled.
controls: Among all 12,442 original historical opportunities calculate coverage and how many parents and held names actually change. Check original cash conservation, parent cap and per-trade margin. Unsupported new settlement/early missing quotes preclude a verified claim. Compare full history, pre-2025 and subsequent periods.
